formulas.K1_0: P*sqrt(pi*L)  [= 1 in units of sqrt(pi*L), per unit load]; undrained elastic pressurized crack
formulas.K1_inf: P*sqrt(pi*L)  [= 1]; drained elastic pressurized crack (stress field independent of moduli)
formulas.V1_0: pi*(1-nu_u)*P*L^2/G  [= pi*(1-nu_u) in units of L^2/G]
formulas.p_faces_0: 2*(nu_u-nu)/(alpha*(1-2*nu))  per unit applied traction (undrained pressure at the faces)
formulas.K2_0: 0  (undrained bulk + zero applied traction -> no instantaneous deformation)
formulas.K2_inf: 0  (p -> uniform 1 -> effective stress uniform alpha*delta_ij -> no crack-tip field)
formulas.V2_inf: 0  (uniform free swelling; a crack is invisible to a uniform effective stress)
